create_Request_message: create a Request protobuf message with client_id and request_data fields for gRPC calls
create_Response_message: create a Response protobuf message with server_id and response_data fields for gRPC replies

review_Response_descriptor: review the Response message descriptor fields including server_id as int64 and response_data as string
